name: ValentaIN: Ore ga Valentine da!!
original_name: バレンタIN 俺がバレンタインだ!!
source: Barnaby and Kotetsu are lovers. They had been happy, but then, they had a fight. Can they reconcile in time for their first Valentine's Day?
